en: The postcard features four black-and-white photographic views of a European city. The images include a hilly riverside area with a prominent clocktower on a hilltop, a lively public square with cafes and old buildings, a close-up of the iconic clocktower (with the word 'Uhrturm'), and an elevated panoramic view looking south across the city and its main river. There is some German text labeling the images.
